# Genre

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Genre`](gmeow-Genre.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Genre>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)

A contested, registry-independent, lineage-bearing information object used to characterise creative works. Like [`gmeow:Language`](gmeow-Language.md), a genre is a first-class individual-bearing class; it is never a subclass tree and never a privileged winner of a genre dispute (Principles 5, 9).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Genre`](gmeow-Genre.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
